title: Returned-Payment Advance on Reinstatement: Community Rules & Site Care Desk Guidance
content:
A returned-payment advance of the plan fee in force is added to the reinstatement payment under Community Rules & Site Care. It turns on the returned payments on the Home-Site Lease ledger within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date and on any certified-funds-only restriction on the Home-Site Lease:

- two or more returned payments, or the lease under a certified-funds-only restriction: 2 months of the plan fee in force;
- exactly one returned payment without that restriction: 1 month of the plan fee in force;
- none otherwise.

The advance is added to the payment after every amount allowed to stay on the statement has been subtracted and the zero floor applied.

## Truth table

| Certified-funds-only restriction on the lease | Returned payments in the 12 months | Advance |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | 2 months |
| no | two or more | 2 months |
| no | exactly one | 1 month |
| no | none | none |

## Hypothetical case

With a plan fee in force of $60.00, chosen for illustration, a lease under a certified-funds-only restriction and no returned payment carries an advance of $120.00; an unrestricted lease with one returned payment carries $60.00.
